create_dynamic_crf_layer: create a DynamicCRF layer with configurable vocab size, low rank, and beam size parameters
compute_crf_log_likelihood: compute the conditional log-likelihood of target sequences given emission scores using forward
decode_crf_viterbi: decode the most likely output sequence using the Viterbi algorithm via forward_decoder
compute_crf_transition_score: compute emission and transition scores for a target sequence using _compute_score
approximate_crf_normalizer: approximate the CRF normalizing factor Z(x) using beam search via _compute_normalizer
